ios.desc:
Elara puts the news and events actually happening around you on a live map: no feed to scroll, no login required.

Open the app and pins drop onto the map for what's happening nearby: local news, events, civic updates, and more, each one summarized in a few lines, with a link straight back to the original source.

WHAT YOU GET
• A live map of your city: tap any pin to read the full story
• Filter by what you care about: Art, Food, Money, Tech, Sports, Festivals, Politics
• "Near me" instantly center the map on your exact location
• Covers Bangalore, Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai, Hyderabad, Pune, and Kolkata
• Share any story straight to WhatsApp, Instagram, or wherever you like

NO LOGIN, EVER
Elara works the moment you open it, no sign-up, no account, no password. Your device remembers your progress on its own.

EARN YOUR WAY IN
Read stories, share them with friends, and earn points to unlock more cities on the map. Invite a friend and you both get a bonus.

Every story links back to the original publisher: Elara summarizes, it doesn't replace real journalism.

No login. No noise. Just what's actually happening near you, live on a map.

quotes.text:
Simple idea: You see news as pins and tap to read it. Crawler runs twice a day (can change it based on demand). Earn points by interacting and sharing and then unlock more cities. Would love to know if you'll love this simple app taking 5 mins of your day?
Available on both Play and App store: "Elara - Local News and Events".
App store: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/elara-local-news-events/id6810100356
Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.uncoverroadsapp.elara&pcampaignid=web_share
